definitions.explanation: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}を{開|あ}けてください。

examples.notes: 口に合う = to suit one's taste

examples.japanese: {口|くち}が{堅|かた}い{人|ひと}です。
examples.english: They are a person who can keep secrets.

notes: Many idiomatic expressions: {口|くち}に{合|あ}う (suit one's taste), {口|くち}が{堅|かた}い (tight-lipped), {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い (loose-lipped). Also used for openings: {入|い}り{口|ぐち} (entrance), {出|で}{口|ぐち} (exit).
